text_block_list.text:
It happened right at the start of the new 
year. At Nakayama Racecourse—
—Waaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Cesario is in the lead! Cesario in the 
lead! Out in front is Cesario—she crosses 
the finish line!!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Taking a brilliant 1st place is Cesario! 
Clear skies ahead as she heads for 
spring's Oka Sho! Cesario takes a 
magnificent victory!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
In the main event—along the Triple Tiara 
route. I will without fail show you a 
cornerstone performance.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"...With this, Cesario-san has two 
consecutive wins since her debut race at 
the end of last year."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: On top of that, this time—
choice_data_list:
...The level of competition in these races 
is high.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: You are quite right.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
With an immature body that has only just 
transitioned from the Junior Class to the 
Classic Class, running a distance as long 
as 2000m—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
And surrounded by promising newcomers 
aiming for the Triple Crown, she claimed a 
magnificent victory... Truly terrifying.

Cesario was finally beginning to make a 
name for herself. And that wasn't all—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Preparations are complete. I shall now 
head out for the mock race.
choice_data_list:
Yeah. I'd like you to observe and judge 
carefully.

Yeah. I want you to watch closely... and 
see for yourself.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: I am aware. —Excuse me, then.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi, Messiah! Looking forward to working 
with you today.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes, Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
You've already experienced so many races, 
including Junior Class GⅠs... Please allow 
me to learn from your running.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! —Hey, Messiah. I really love how 
clever you are.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You treated the Junior Class as a 
preparation period. Very wise decision! A 
sensible and brave choice indeed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I've been looking forward to 
today. —To see how far the strength I 
forged in serious battle can take me 
against you!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Me too...! I'm not backing down today, 
Messiah!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
No, not just today. It's the start of the 
Triple Tiara—!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
I won't give an inch to anyone. Today, I'm 
going to pour all of those feelings into 
the race!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...It's started to snow, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
You're right...! But it's only light snow, 
so maybe it won't affect the race that 
much?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Besides... hehe. It doesn't seem cold at 
all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. Because our hearts are burning 
with passion!

And so, amid light flurries of snow, the 
mock race with Rhein Kraft, Daring Heart, 
and the others began...

There was no doubt it was a crucial race 
that would divine the future, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Not yet! I'm staying in the lead just 
like this!! I won't give it up, haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(Ugh...! Heart-san isn't dropping back! 
The final stretch... At this rate, it'll 
come right down to the wire—)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Right here, right now!! Go, go, gooooooo!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
(!? Craft-san is coming from the far 
outside...! Oh no! She's catching... 
up...!!)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ...aaaaaaaahhh...!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry. I did everything I could, 
but fell just short... finishing in 3rd 
place.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
There was barely any gap at the finish. I 
don't think there's a huge difference in 
their abilities. However—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Daring Heart-san's sheer tenacity. And 
Rhein Kraft-san's final burst of speed, 
leaping into the lead from back there...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
In each case, I felt it was strength 
forged and polished by throwing themselves 
into fierce battles since the Junior 
Class.
choice_data_list:
We were really shown her "capacity for 
growth"...

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. And that includes Cesario, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
All three of them possessed extraordinary 
talent from the start. So I was braced for 
this to some degree, but—

"It exceeded my expectations." That 
reality weighed heavily on my chest.

...I boot up the computer and access the 
shared cloud folder with Air Messiah.

Next, I open the "Training Schedule" and 
"Rival Data Analysis" files— and update 
the version numbers for each.

From "Training_Schedule_34" to "35". From 
"Rival_Data_Analysis_28" to "29".
choice_data_list: (Now I just need to print this out...)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: "...Trainer. This is—"
choice_data_list:
If it didn't go as expected, let's revise 
the plan.

text_block_list.text:
"Let's update our rival data. We need to 
revise the training schedule."

To win, even against "rivals who have 
grown far beyond expectations."
choice_data_list:
Let's take it one step at a time and do 
what needs to be done.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: ...You're absolutely right, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"It hasn't changed, and I won't change it. 
Steadily, reliably, handling each task one 
by one."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for printing these out. Let us 
review the documents at once and identify 
which sections need updating.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, have you heard 
about this, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
For example, something like this. Even 
with a piece of paper barely 0.1 mm thick—

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, if you fold a piece of paper 
42 times, it will reach the moon.
choice_data_list:
...That's why we should be able to reach 
it, too.

...That's why we should be able to reach 
it, too.

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"Yes. No matter how grandiose or difficult 
a goal it may be."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
We shall make it reach. Through building 
up each step, without fail.

The big stage draws near: the Triple 
Tiara's opening leg, the Oka Sho... 
...Yet, she does not waver.

True to ourselves, solid and steady. The 
final training period begins—!
